signature: SUBROUTINE ZTGSNA( JOB, HOWMNY, SELECT, N, A, LDA, B, LDB, VL,

params.name: job
howmny
params.reference:
-   `= 'A'`: compute condition numbers for all eigenpairs;
-   `= 'S'`: compute condition numbers for selected eigenpairs specified by the array `SELECT`.

params.name: SELECT
params.reference: If `HOWMNY = 'S'`, `SELECT` specifies the eigenpairs for which condition numbers are required. To select condition numbers for the corresponding j-th eigenvalue and/or eigenvector, `SELECT(j)` must be set to .TRUE.. If `HOWMNY = 'A'`, `SELECT` is not referenced.

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the square matrix pair (A, B). $N \ge 0$.

params.name: A
params.reference: The upper triangular matrix A in the pair (A,B).

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: B
params.reference: The upper triangular matrix B in the pair (A, B).

params.name: ldb
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array B. $\mathrm{LDB} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: VL
params.reference: IF `JOB = 'E'` or 'B', `VL` must contain left eigenvectors of (A, B), corresponding to the eigenpairs specified by `HOWMNY` and `SELECT`. The eigenvectors must be stored in consecutive columns of `VL`, as returned by ZTGEVC. If `JOB = 'V'`, `VL` is not referenced.

params.name: ldvl
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array `VL`. $\mathrm{LDVL} \ge 1$; and If `JOB = 'E'` or 'B', $\mathrm{LDVL} \ge N$.

params.name: VR
params.reference: IF `JOB = 'E'` or 'B', `VR` must contain right eigenvectors of (A, B), corresponding to the eigenpairs specified by `HOWMNY` and `SELECT`. The eigenvectors must be stored in consecutive columns of `VR`, as returned by ZTGEVC. If `JOB = 'V'`, `VR` is not referenced.

params.name: ldvr
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array `VR`. $\mathrm{LDVR} \ge 1$; If `JOB = 'E'` or 'B', $\mathrm{LDVR} \ge N$.

params.name: s
params.reference: If `JOB = 'E'` or 'B', the reciprocal condition numbers of the selected eigenvalues, stored in consecutive elements of the array. If `JOB = 'V'`, S is not referenced.

params.name: DIF
params.reference: If `JOB = 'V'` or 'B', the estimated reciprocal condition numbers of the selected eigenvectors, stored in consecutive elements of the array. If the eigenvalues cannot be reordered to compute `DIF(j)`, `DIF(j)` is set to 0; this can only occur when the true value would be very small anyway. For each eigenvalue/vector specified by `SELECT`, `DIF` stores a Frobenius norm-based estimate of Difl. If `JOB = 'E'`, `DIF` is not referenced.

params.name: mm
params.reference: The number of elements in the arrays S and `DIF`. $\mathrm{MM} \ge M$.

params.name: m
params.reference: The number of elements of the arrays S and `DIF` used to store the specified condition numbers; for each selected eigenvalue one element is used. If `HOWMNY = 'A'`, M is set to N.

params.name: WORK
params.reference: On exit, if `INFO = 0`, `WORK(1)` returns the optimal `LWORK`.

params.name: lwork
params.reference: The dimension of the array `WORK`. $\mathrm{LWORK} \ge \max (1,N)$. If `JOB = 'V'` or 'B', $\mathrm{LWORK} \ge \max (1,2 \, N \, N)$.

params.name: IWORK
params.reference: If `JOB = 'E'`, `IWORK` is not referenced.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: Successful exit
-   `< 0`: If `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value

untranslated: check -15: tests the output argument M (its value is computed, not passed in)
WORK.minLength: local LWMIN is assigned inside nested control flow
